text: Return all approved drugs indicated for schizophrenia. Select the ChEMBL ID, preferred name, canonical SMILES, EFO ID, indication label (EFO term), and max phase for the indication. Source from molecule_dictionary, drug_indication, and compound_structures. Join molecule_dictionary to drug_indication on molregno. Join compound_structures to molecule_dictionary on molregno. Filter where max phase for indication equals 4 and the indication label contains 'schizophrenia'.
